item.title: Straight out of high school right to Super Bowl XLIX for Seahawks dancer
item.description: As the Hawks head to Super Bowl LX, we talk to a local coach who once cheered for them at a previous Super Bowl straight out of high school.

item.title: Mike Macdonald's focus on defense a perfect fit for Seattle Seahawks heading into Super Bowl
item.description: Seattle Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald has helped build a gritty, hard-nosed team with a focus on defense. The Seahawks had one of the best defenses in the NFL in the 2025 season.

item.title: Decades on the sideline: Photographer captures Seattle Seahawks history
item.description: Longtime Seahawks photographer Corky Trewin is reflecting on 44 years behind the camera documenting the franchise.

item.title: WA millionaires tax proposal has arrived, Gov. Ferguson wants changes
item.description: It has been a lightning rod issue in Olympia: a proposed millionaires tax. Gov. Bob Ferguson has said he would support it, but now, he's rejecting at least one initial proposal from state senators.

item.title: Redmond, WA IKEA plan and pickup center to open Feb. 11
item.description: IKEA will open a smaller “Plan & order point with Pick-up" store in Redmond Town Center on Feb. 11.

item.title: Deadly Seattle teen shootings renew debate over school safety, police presence
item.description: Seattle Police Chief Shon Barnes called the Rainier Beach shooting a "loss of potential," a phrase that has become painfully familiar in recent years.

item.title: Victims of Seattle shooting near Rainier Beach HS identified
item.description: The two Rainier Beach High Schools students who were fatally shot and killed at a bus stop outside the school have been identified as Traveiah Houfmuse and Tyjon Stewart.

item.title: 3D printing enthusiasts worry over broad language in WA 'ghost gun' bill
item.description: A proposed Washington bill targeting 3D-printed “ghost guns" is raising alarm among 3D printing hobbyists and makers.

item.title: Four-game winning streak snapped for Seattle Kraken in 4-2 loss to Ducks
item.description: Cutter Gauthier scored his 25th goal of the season and the Anaheim Ducks defeated the Seattle Kraken 4-2 on Tuesday night to win their final game before the Olympic break.

item.title: 1 killed in Renton, WA homicide
item.description: Renton police are investigating a fatal shooting reported Tuesday night near Northeast 4th Street and Queen Avenue NE.
